Class Resolution

java.lang.Object
forj.examples.typeclasses.Resolution
public final class Resolution extends Object
Which given gets picked. There are several Show<Integer> and Show<Money> instances around; each method below shows one rule. Nearest scope wins:
  1. a local given declared earlier in the block
  2. the enclosing method's using parameters
  3. givens in the enclosing classes
  4. givens brought in with import static (see ImportedGivens)
  5. givens next to the type class or the data type (Show.integer, Money.show)
Two matches at the same level is a compile error, not a guess.
